translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Puang Yesus dipa'kasallei anna dipakahoa' sulena lako Yerusalem
Tappana la umpenandai Yerusalem Puang Yesus sola passikolanna, sikahuku'pi tondä' Betfage anna Betania dio Tanete Zaitun, iya ussuam dua passikolanna mendiolo
naua: “Le'ba'koa' lako dio tondä' tapenandaia'. Aka sulekoa' too lako, iya ullambi'unna' mesa keledai lundaha disäke' lombe', tadeempi disäkei. Bukkaia' anna umbabaia' dio mai.
Anna maka' too deengkoa' ungkutanai naua: ‘Akanna mualaia'?’ uaanni: ‘Aka napahalluam Debata, anna la bale' dipasule siam sule.’”
Iya le'ba'i siaham anna nalambi' si'da mesa keledai lundaha dio olo ba'ba disäke' lombe', dio bihim lalam. Iya nabukkaim.
Wattu eta too deem sanaka-naka tau dio nalambi'. Naitanna indo tau nabukkai, iya tappa nakambahoannim naua: “Akanna umbukkaia'?”
Iya natimba'im susi indo tula' bali napakahi'diam Puang Yesus. Iya nauai mandam indo tau: “O, iya babaia' lao.”
Iya naalam indo keledai anna le'ba'i nababaam Puang Yesus. Sulei lako, muäläiim jubana anna nalapi'ianni, mane nasäkei Puang Yesus.
Wattu eta too buda tau muäläi jubana anna naampa'i lako lalam la naolanna Puang Yesus tanda pa'pakasallena, anna deem toi duka' tau muampa' palapa andulam naala lako bela'.
Ingganna tau to ullahui susi yolona teem ibundinna sikaahhe naua:

content.text: Katambasam to sule illaam sanganna Debata!
Natamba' Puang Allataala pessubunna tomahaja Daud to la dipotomahaja allo di dako'na.
Tapa'kasalleia' Puang Allataala To Handam Matande!”

content: Landa'na Puang Yesus lako Yerusalem, tappa melolo tama Banua Debata anna napahessa asanni lao pali'. Sapo' aka la bengim, iya bale' le'ba' lako Betania solai sapulo dua passikolanna.
Puang Yesus umpanata'i kaju ara
Masiä polei, mengkalao oom Puang Yesus sola sapulo dua passikolanna. Umpelleinna tondä' Betania, iya tadea'um ia Puang Yesus.

Mennenne'um lao, iya muita mambelam kaju ara tumalumbum daunna. Iya napenandaim lako aka naua inabanna: “Umba ke deenni buana.” Sapo' sulei lako, anggam daunna nalambi', tadeem buana aka abana taia opi wattunna la kembua.
Tappa napanata'i Puang Yesus naua: “Tä'um iko deem la naande hupatau buamu sule lako salako-lakona.” Iya indo tula'na nahingngi asam duka' passikolanna.
Puang Yesus ussua lao to sibalu'-balu' illaam Banua Debata

Tappana sulei lako Yerusalem Puang Yesus sola passikolanna, iya le'ba'im tama pa'hanteanna Banua Debata. Sulei tama, iya ullambi'um to si balu'-balu' illaam. Tappa nasua siaham lao Puang Yesus anna napembalisannii mejana indo to si ussuka'i doi'na to buttu dio mai botto senga' anna usseham okkosanna to si umbalu' dangam-dangam.
Anna ingganna to la umbaba aka-aka tä' napäbäi muola tama Banua Debata.
Mane ma'pa'guhui lako tau buda naua: “Tä' daka tia puha tisuha' illaam Battakada Debata naua:
sapo' umpadadi hia' iko pa'mesaanna pa'bulele kalasi anna pa'tombonganna to maboko allo.”

Tappana nahingngi kapala sando sola to ullatta' Pepaondonganna Musa kadadiam ia too, iya ma'pattujuim la napeä lalanna anna mala dipatei Puang Yesus. Aka silele mahea' lako tappana muita buda tau nakapilla'i pepa'guhuanna.
Mahammoi, messubum oom Puang Yesus sola passikolanna umpellei Yerusalem.
Diona sambajam diala pepa'guhuam dio mai kaju ara mahekko'
Tappana masiä pole, mebengngi'-bengngi'pi anna liu oom Puang Yesus sola passikolanna lako indo kaju ara. Iya naitam mahekko'um sule dokko waka'na.
Iya nakilalai siaham Petrus indo puha naua Puang Yesus teem isamai' lako indo kaju ara. Iya ma'kadam Petrus naua: “O Tuangguhu, petua' siai dio kaju ara puhanna umpanata'i, iya mahekko' siaham.”
Iya nauam Puang Yesus: “Katappa'ikoa' Puang Allataala!
Aka maka' ussua inde dio buntu mentieli' tama le'bo', iya la mala si'da tiäkä' tama ke deennia' kamatappasammu. Sapo' maka' bata-batakoa', iya tä' la mala dadi.
Iam too anna kuuaammokoa', iai too umpelaua' längäm Puang Allataala sola ponno kapahhannuam, tä' mala tala untahimaa'.
Anna maka' la ma'sambajangkoa' anna deenni pi'di' penabammua' lako mesa tau, ampunniia' yolo mane ma'sambajangkoa' anna mala naampunniangkoa' kasalaammu Ambemu yabo suhuga.”
[Sapo' maka' tä'koa' muampunni kasalaanna padammu, iya tä'koa' too duka' la naampunniam kasalaammu Ambemu yabo suhuga.]
Pekutanaanna to umpeängam tuntungam su'be' Puang Yesus

Iya ma'pasuleim sule lako Yerusalem Puang Yesus sola passikolanna. Pissam wattu mahassanni ma'lao-lao illaam Banua Debata, iya sulem sanaka-naka kapala sando anna to ullatta' Pepaondonganna Musa sola matua ulunna to Yahudi umpellambi'i Puang Yesus
anna nauai: “Aka isanga umpolalam anna umpogau'i inde mai ingganna pa'pogausam, anna menna umbeengko kakuasaam?”
Sapo' natimba' naua: “La kukutanaikoa' duka' yolo, puhapia' untimba'i mane kutulasangkoa' duka' menna umbeennä' inde kakuasaam.
Menna umbeenni kakuasaam Yohanes anna si mantedo'i? Puang Allataala haka hupatau haka? Timba'ipia'!”
Iya sipa'tula'-tula'um naua: “Mapahhi' la ditimba'i, aka taua hia' manii: ‘Kakuasaanna Puang Allataala,’ iya la nauaammakia' too: ‘Akanna tä'ia' ungkatappa'i?’
Iya taua hia' manii: ‘Kakuasaanna hupatau,’ iya tä' ohi aka inde Yohanes nakatappa'i asam tau naua: ‘Abana mesa nabi.’”

Lambi' angga ham pentimba'na lako Puang Yesus naua: “Tä' kiissam la kitimba'i indo pekutanaammu.” Nasuhum naua Puang Yesus: “Maka' susi, iya tä' duka' kuaku la kutulasangkoa' menna umbeennä' kakuasaam nasuhum kupogau' kaha-kaha ia too.”
